resources.string: KidGuard prevents curious little hands from leaving the app when active.
KidsGuard uses system protection to prevent accidental app uninstallation and manage wellbeing restrictions.

With parent or guardian consent, KidsGuard uses Accessibility Service to identify active apps and browser or YouTube content, enforce parent-selected blocks and screen-time rules, and detect attempts to disable protection.
Transparent parental controls for safer child devices and healthier screen time.

KidsGuard Screen is a parental-control and child-safety app for devices managed by a parent or legal guardian.

Core features:
- Live location and parent-defined safe-zone alerts
- App inventory, app blocking and screen-time limits
- Adult and gambling website protection
- YouTube and browser activity visible to the linked parent
- Scheduled device lock and tamper alerts
- Persistent notification while child-device monitoring is active

KidsGuard clearly discloses monitoring, requests consent before sensitive access, and shares child-device information only with the linked family account. It does not sell personal data or use monitoring data for advertising. KidsGuard must not be used to monitor adults or anyone without lawful parental or guardian authority.
